hypothesis: Perpetuals whose recently settled funding is extreme relative to the cross-section earn a positive after-cost return over the next ~24h when held against the crowd (short the highest, long the lowest), net of the funding they actually pay or receive.

universe.label: STATIC-40; frozen current-universe / survivor-biased (same artifact as EDGE04, all 40 symbols, not the CORE-10-ELIGIBLE-9 headline and not CAND_FIXED18)
universe.why_not_smaller: CORE-10-ELIGIBLE-9 and fixed-18 are too narrow for a k=5 per side cross-section; static-40 is the widest frozen list the repo already owns
universe.eligibility_at_decision: symbol is in the artifact AND its first settled funding event and first 4h kline are each at least 30 days before D AND its funding sequence in the available-at-decision window [D-24h, D) (every event with T + 300s <= D) passes costs.check_funding_sequence as specified in signal.sequence_check AND its 1d bars needed for the R unit exist
universe.below_min_eligible: no new cohort that day (book flat); counted and reported, not INCOMPLETE
universe.listing: a symbol enters the eligible set only after the 30-day age rule; no back-fill before its first archive row
universe.delisting_or_halt: a missing 4h bar, mark bar or funding event inside an open episode makes that episode INCOMPLETE (never filled, never dropped silently); a symbol that is delisted or halted is ineligible from the first decision whose required inputs are missing

signal.name: F24
signal.definition: F24(s, D) = sum of the settled fundingRate of symbol s over every funding event whose nominal time T satisfies T + availability_lag in (D - 24h, D], i.e. D - 24h - 300s < T <= D - 300s; for whole-hour nominal times this is exactly T in [D - 24h, D) (Cowork 6459484792 B1)
signal.units: fraction of notional per 24h (interval-agnostic: exactly 3 events on an 8h grid, 6 on 4h, 24 on 1h; the event at T = D is never in the window and never required)
signal.why: the spec holds each position ~24h, so the look-back equals the hold horizon; a 24h sum is the only window that normalises the 1h/4h/8h Binance cadences without a free parameter. Not tuned; no alternative window is evaluated
signal.settled_only: a funding event counts only once its archived calc_time (time_ms) <= T + 60 s (costs.FUNDING_TIME_TOLERANCE_MS) AND T + availability_lag <= D
signal.nominal_time: range_vwap_rev.t_nom (whole hour within 60 s, interval in {1,2,4,8})
signal.incomplete: an expected event missing, duplicated or off-grid in the window [D - 24h, D) makes the symbol ineligible at D; the event at T = D is not yet available and is never required; if fewer than min_eligible symbols remain the day has no cohort
signal.sequence_check: costs.check_funding_sequence(symbol, rows, start_ms = D - 24h, end_ms = D): rows are every archived event from the phase anchor (the event at or immediately before D - 24h) through the last event with T + 300s <= D; covered interval [D - 24h, D), so the event at D is not covered and must not be passed. Equivalent boundary statement (Codex 6459518132 item 1): start_exclusive = D - 24h - lag, end_inclusive = D - lag, phase anchor = the latest nominal event at or before the lower boundary; for whole-hour nominal times both select exactly [D - 24h, D)
signal.runner_requirement: the runner MUST filter the funding rows to T + availability_lag <= D BEFORE calling costs.check_funding_sequence(start_ms = D - 24h, end_ms = D), and MUST assert that no row passed has T + availability_lag > D; an event not yet available can neither complete nor be required by the sequence (Codex 6459663759 N3)

selection.rule: rank eligible symbols by F24 at D; ties broken by symbol name ascending
selection.k_source: the existing EDGE04 H2 rotation k=5 constant; fixed, not searched
selection.sign_filter: none: pure rank, no threshold on the level of F24
selection.duplicates: at most one open position per symbol per book; cohorts never overlap because exit precedes the next entry

execution.cadence: one cohort per book per UTC day
execution.entry: market at the open of the first 4h kline that opens at or after D + availability lag, i.e. 04:00 UTC
execution.exit: market at the open of the 4h kline 24h after entry (04:00 UTC next day), or earlier by the protective stop
execution.funding_held: every funding event with entry <= T < exit (costs.py rule): exactly 3 on an 8h grid
execution.r_unit: stop distance = 2.0 x TR-SMA14 of the 15 closed 1d bars ending at D (costs.tr_sma14); 1R = that distance x quantity
execution.stop_path: 4h bars: gap-open first, then conservative stop-first; a stop the bar opens through fills at the open. The entry bar itself (the 04:00-08:00 UTC 4h bar) IS stop-checked from its 04:00 open with the same conservative rule: gap/open first, then stop-first over its full high/low range (Cowork 6459484792 N2, Codex 6459518132 item 3)
execution.rebalance_roll: a symbol re-selected at D+1 is closed and re-opened as a new episode (both fills charged); no carry-over

account.lev_cap_rule: if a cohort would exceed the cap, every position in it is scaled down by the same factor
account.books: long and short each run their own 10000 USDT book

execution.filters: historical stepSize, minQty and minNotional; quantities floored, never rounded up

costs.fee: Binance UM VIP0 taker 0.05% each fill (costs.TAKER)
costs.slippage: slip-v1 on 4h closed bars with the slip-cal-v1 crypto coefficient; the 0.05% unfitted fallback each market fill while SLIP-C-UNFITTED
costs.funding: actual signed settled rate x funding-mark-proxy-v1 notional at each held event; longs pay positive, shorts receive positive

stress_rows.base_x1: fees x1, slippage x1, funding as settled
stress_rows.all_variable_costs_x1.5: fees x1.5, slippage x1.5, funding paid x1.5, funding received / 1.5
stress_rows.all_variable_costs_x2: fees x2, slippage x2, funding paid x2, funding received / 2
stress_rows.funding_zero: report-only: price P&L with fees+slippage, funding set to 0 (carry vs price decomposition)
stress_rows.entry_latency_1bar: report-only: entry and exit both one 4h bar later

costs.stress_rule: stress multiplies only costs and never inflates received funding; stress rows reprice the same episodes and are not variants

calibration.use: warm-up and eligibility only; no result reported

windows.split_source: identical to the EDGE04 / R4 split boundaries
windows.split_rule: fresh books per split; 4h signal interval; lookback 180 bars (30 days), horizon 6 bars (24h); purge max(180,6) bars, embargo 1 bar (splits.py); no episode, look-back or hold crosses a boundary
windows.prep_access: nothing on or after 2026-09-28T00:00:00Z is read during prep; the coverage tool refuses it

diagnostics.rule: report-only market-neutral sum of P-SHORT and P-LONG cohorts; can never be promoted or rescue a failed primary

baselines.rule: 1000 seeded random books: each day draw k symbols uniformly without replacement from that day's eligible set; same cadence, hold, stop, sizing and costs
equal-risk side-matched book over every eligible symbol each day; same cadence, hold, stop and costs
sign-flipped selection (short the k lowest / long the k highest F24); report-only rank-information check

trial_budget.rule: no result-dependent variant, no alternative k / window / lag / stop; diagnostics, baselines and stress rows never replace a failed primary

metrics: net R per episode and per cohort, per side
fold-level mean net R and PF
gross vs funding vs fee/slippage decomposition
stressed mean net R at x1.5 and x2
max equity DD, closed-R DD, longest underwater days, and the DD tier that applied
annualized after-cost return, return / max DD (Calmar), total net R / closed-R DD, exposure time; reported together with PF, net expectancy and trade count (Codex 6457388087)
worst cohort net R, 1st-percentile episode net R
daily turnover (notional traded / equity), position notional / prior-24h quote volume

per side and per fold: count and share of selected symbols with positive / zero / negative F24 at selection, and the funding contribution (sum of funding_actual) vs price contribution to net R, so a market-wide funding-sign shift is visible (Codex ruling 2, 6457951657)

gates.data: every walk-forward fold has at most 2% INCOMPLETE episodes and no unresolved accounting row; otherwise the side is INCOMPLETE, not FAIL
gates.activity: at least 1000 closed episodes per side across walk-forward and at least 200 cohort days in every fold

fold_stability.rule: mean net R > 0 in at least 4 of 5 walk-forward folds

expectancy.lcb: 95% lower bound of combined walk-forward mean net R > 0 by moving-block bootstrap of daily cohort means, block 30 cohorts, 10000 resamples, seed 20261028

gates.baselines: mean net R above the 95th percentile of the 1000 B0 book means, and above B1 mean net R

stress.rule: x1.5 > 0 is a PASS gate; x2 > 0 is required for promotion to shadow/PAPER and otherwise reported

drawdown_and_tail.tier_rule: the DD gate passes when the ordinary tier OR the profitability_rescue tier holds, AND every all-path ceiling holds; the rescue applies to any base DD <= 55% (no lower bound), so the gate is monotone: a lower-DD book never fails where a higher-DD book with the same ratios passes (Codex 6459518132 N1); base DD > 55% or x1.5 DD > 65% is FAIL on any path
drawdown_and_tail.policy: Owner high-DD/profitability rule as encoded by Codex 6457763292: higher DD is not an automatic rejection when after-cost return, cost stress and recovery are credible; the tier is preregistered and no DD threshold may be relaxed after holdout P&L is seen

gates.multiplicity: Holm alpha 0.05 across P-SHORT and P-LONG on the bootstrap p-value of mean net R <= 0
gates.verdict: PASS only if every gate passes for that primary (the DD gate via its preregistered tier rule); long and short are judged separately

promotion_allocation.rule: a passing book enters shadow at a risk allocation that cannot dominate the portfolio

failure_modes.incomplete_funding: symbol ineligible at D; inside a hold the episode is INCOMPLETE; >2% per fold makes the side INCOMPLETE
failure_modes.missing_symbol: a universe symbol with no data in a split is reported; it never silently shrinks the universe below min_eligible
failure_modes.holdout_timestamp: any access at or after 2026-09-28T00:00:00Z during prep or development is refused (pit.Access guard; edge05_coverage refuses before reading)
failure_modes.missing_bar: no forward fill; the episode is INCOMPLETE

coverage_check.mode: manifest metadata only, streamed; no archive opened, no rate or price read
